title: A Table for Dalla
summary: Helm Vesper says Dalla Brook is going short. 4 bundles of flax and a visit would help, before the vigil.
offer_text: "Dalla Brook will not ask, so I am asking for them. Go and see what is wanted, and bring bundles of flax before the vigil. The stock at the herb walk is the town's, and this is what it is for."
turn_in_text: "Thank you. It is the small things that keep a town."

objectives.text: Visit Dalla Brook and ask what is wanted
Take 4 bundles of flax from the herb walk
Hand the bundles of flax to Dalla Brook
